context_requirements: Intact extrinsic or intrinsic apoptotic signalling (caspase-8/-9 competent)
Basal XIAP expression and/or cIAP1/2 dependence for NF-kB and MAPK survival signalling
No strong pre-existing apoptotic block (e.g. high BCL2/BCL-xL, low caspase expression)
Proliferating cells with intact G2/M checkpoint machinery for cell-cycle arrest readout
falsifiers: No decrease in BIRC5, CCNB1, CDK1 or other G2/M genes at 24 h in any line
No increase in caspase, BH3-only or stress/apoptosis genes at 24 h
Transcriptional profile indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines
Response only in lines lacking XIAP expression or with homozygous XIAP deletion

evidence.supports: XIAP inhibition (Smac peptide/embelin) sensitises pancreatic cancer cells to TRAIL-induced apoptosis, indicating XIAP blockade engages caspase-dependent apoptosis
Embelin, an XIAP inhibitor, enhances TRAIL-mediated apoptosis in glioma cells via caspase-8/-9 and -3/-7 activation and post-transcriptional c-FLIP downregulation
Embelin reduces gastric cancer cell viability, induces apoptosis and S/G2-M arrest, and downregulates XIAP, CDK1, CDC25B/C, cyclin B1 and CDK2
Embelin downregulates androgen receptor and XIAP-dependent survival in prostate cancer cells and shows supra-additive antiproliferative/apoptotic effects with antiandrogen
Embelin induces autophagic and apoptotic cell death in oral squamous carcinoma cells with LC3-II conversion, p62 degradation and caspase activation
